subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: What permanent Copilot native-search capability and Plugin SDK contract should OpenClaw support?
rationale: Upstream availability is model-limited, the Copilot catalog lacks an exact capability bit, and the selected helper module is public API, so maintainer intent is required for both fallback behavior and SDK ownership.

options.title: Capability gate with fallback
options.body: Add provider-owned eligibility, preserve managed search when native support is unavailable, and keep the helper internal unless external plugins need it.

options.title: Public capability API
options.body: Add capability-safe routing while formally supporting and documenting the helper for third-party provider plugins.

options.title: Explicit opt-in accepts failures
options.body: Document that `provider: openai` may fail on unsupported models or accounts and retain broad family matching.

recommendation.title: Capability gate with fallback
recommendation.body: Add provider-owned eligibility, preserve managed search when native support is unavailable, and keep the helper internal unless external plugins need it.

likelyOwner.reason: The provider SDK seam and Copilot routing history make this the strongest available owner for the contract decision.
